descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S21 Existing specs: photo reading is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt is passed on unchanged

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Photo scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. (TFA-94425 AC 1)
  • T3 The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is ported word for word. Only the request format is adapted to Gemini's API, and the instructions are not rewritten. (TFA-94425 AC 2; TFA-94425 AC 3; TFA-94425 AC 4)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Provider configuration (api project, no network)

When Read the default vision provider/model, route a photo, and build the Vertex request

Then The default vision provider is Vertex with a Gemini Flash model. A photo goes to the configured vision model with the prompt text unchanged, in the native Vertex request shape

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. These are defaults only (DEFAULT_VISION_MODEL gemini-3.6-flash, the model that returned 404 on dev before PR #102). Which model really answered is S22. Word-for-word parity of the census-snf prompt with the p72 prototype (TFA-94425 AC 2, AC 4) is TC-02 S25 (doc-review); TC-09's copy of that check was folded into it

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S21 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S21

Existing specs: photo reading is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt is passed on unchanged

Tickets: TFA-94425 Implement Vision/photo path (ready for qa)

Result: passed in matrix/TC-09.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — defaults photo OCR to Google Vertex Gemini — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — builds the native Vertex photo OCR request with literal-reading controls — expected
  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — routes photos using the explicit vision provider and model — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's api spec e2e/api/providers.spec.ts): it checks the worktree's provider code in-process and calls no deployment, so there is nothing to run on dev; it runs with the local suite (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
